change.cold_work: Fragment discovery, LVP CRC/directory parsing, per-member inspect_flash using the existing VMSTORE verify, resource/size checks and publication of caller-owned certificates.
change.resident_work: Immutable fragment reads via the existing page cache, numeric/UI bindings and the linked loop invoking one pinned LANGVM kernel.
change.handoff: A private size/magic-checked APP flow phase; only resident-owned callbacks and plain certificates survive APP return. No Reader or APP-local function pointer escapes the cold call.
change.retained_checks: Complete container and member CRCs, common opcode/control-target verifier, GRAPH exclusion, epoch checks before/after reads and callbacks, existing 8-KiB loan and catalog/workspace bounds.
change.ELF_evidence: No language_vm::verify, inspect_flash, linked::inspect or VM run in the resident image. VMSTORE has one shared verify and no VM run.
change.scope: The same experimental whole-member linked execution as the first PoC, not production INPUT/editor/dependency-refresh integration. No public ABI version or shipping default changed.

sizes.peak_APP_note: VMSTORE replaces the cold APP before LANGVM is pinned; its 14020 bytes are below the already-required 20476-byte LANGVM peak. Existing fixed prefix/cache and worst-case APP/stage/MSC/FS coexistence budgets are unchanged.
sizes.baseline_note: Fresh same-tree baseline is 4 bytes larger than the older 371312-byte baseline; report the current matched 4308-byte delta, not 4312.

experiment.byte_identical_used_images: PASS: 16 ordinary cached modules byte-identical to LVP members, full image CRC and SHA checked.
experiment.USB_Screen: Continuously attached; every packet/frame CRC and complete eight-rank board required, unchanged timing driver.
experiment.scenario: e2e3, 420 nodes, level 2, depth 8, book off; time from OK on Black selection to complete board.
experiment.warm_comparison: Three searches per stage; exclude first in every stage, use median of repeats 1 and 2. Ordinary first search creates the file cache; linked image is prebuilt, so first-search difference is not an execution-speed claim.

validation.ordinary_file_cache_ASan_UBSan: PASS: both arithmetic/USB modes, publication/load, CRC/key/epoch/quota/OOM/INPUT/ESC and FOCAL.

results.conclusion: Hot speed is retained after removing the resident cold parser/verifier. Same continuously active USB Screen and matched kernel/images; first-search differences are not a matched execution-speed claim.

restoration.evidence: hil-aba/report.json and restore-flash.json; final fingerprint and canonical reg/stk/dump/pwd checked by the original HIL finalizer.

PicoCalc_comparison.USB_mode: Pico completion mode stops screen transmission during search; Classic A/B/A keeps it continuously attached.
PicoCalc_comparison.storage_note: Earlier Pico dispatch optimization moved code from XIP Flash to SRAM at a cost of 16368 additional static bytes. Classic LANGVM already runs from SRAM.
PicoCalc_comparison.STM32_effect: The three newer main commits guard their optimizations to Pico; their report confirms byte-identical STM32 LANGVM and no STM32 hardware flashing.
PicoCalc_comparison.conclusion: Same search/result, but different hardware and USB conditions. No cross-device speedup or claim that USB explains the entire time difference.
